name: Basti
pointBasis: Immutable WUP 2025 coordinate, copied without adjustment.
registryBasis: The official Basti district site directs citizens to UP Bhulekh, and the official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha service exposes Basti district revenue-village map levels. This establishes local/state revenue service custody, not citywide parcel coverage.
blocker: The official BhuNaksha public map shell and level/map endpoints were reachable anonymously, but the plot geometry endpoint returned Missing or invalid Authorization header. A bounded plot-number lookup returned safe plot metadata only; no full geometry was retained. The exact WUP point returned an empty object in the tested village context and is not evidence of citywide absence.
